services.desc: Stand-up paddleboards from $45 for a half day. Grab a board, bring the dog, and float past wild horses on the Salt River. Plus tax. A $150 refundable deposit per board comes back the same day you return it. Holiday weekends carry a 20% surcharge. Every rental comes with the board, an adjustable paddle, a leash, and a life jacket, plus a quick land lesson at pickup if it's your first time. quotes.author: Sarah K.
quotes.text: Rented the Centurion for a birthday weekend at Saguaro Lake. The boat was immaculate and Steve walked us through everything before we hit the water. Already booked our next trip.

quotes.author: Marcus T.
quotes.text: Took the Maverick X3 through Bulldog Canyon. 135 horsepower of pure fun. Steve walked us through everything before we headed out. Will be back for the wakeboat next.

We went to Wave and Ridge while we were in AZ. We had an amazing time, Steve and Kate were amazing help. The seadoos were super nice and easy to load and unload. They even sent us over to a BBQ joint down the street that was amazing after our trip. Definitely would love to visit again! Thanks y’all!

Steve and Kate were extremely friendly. Got the pleasure of renting 4 jet-ski's from them. Came with loud speakers to UP the experience. A nice bonus. Process of pick up and return is super easy and made renting from them stress free. We'll be back for sure

Steve and Kate were awesome to work with. We rented 4 jet skis. Everything was communicated very well from how to operate the equipment and load/unload safely. Definitely would rent again when I’m back!
What a trip..... Host was very kind and informative. From reserving our crafts to returning them was very easy to do. I will be recommend this to all of my friends.
